paragraphs.text: Dear Hiring Team, I am applying for the B2B Product Designer role.
I have three years of experience as a product designer. I work with Figma and design systems.
I conduct qualitative user interviews. I collaborate with product and engineering teams.
I am interested in the B2B product-design focus and the role’s design-systems requirement.
I would welcome the opportunity to discuss my relevant product-design experience in more detail.

caveats.text: Experimentation experience is preferred for the role, but it is not verified for the candidate.
